author: reek
body: What this pins is not the numbers, which are arbitrary and say so. It is that a program CAN perform them: before this, mentioning locate type-checked and then died at emit with CDX2040, so no program using location could be built at all. Every line below is an operation actually performed through its effect row.

author: reek
body: The two `fixed` lines are the load-bearing ones. Both must read False. If a future chapter drives real hardware and forgets to flip its own answer to True, a caller has no way to tell a reading from a placeholder, and this test is the thing that says so out loud.
